title: NanoKVM-Go compact USB-C KVM supports WiFi 6 and 4K capture

description: Kickstarter recently featured the RootBoard, a Raspberry Pi-powered handheld Linux computer aimed at makers, developers, educators, cyberdeck builders, and users interested in a compact open-hardware Linux terminal.
